text:
maya: Quick follow-up to the validator DSL RFC — we need a pragmatic plan for safetensors streaming verification + warmup telemetry before the next canary. Thoughts?

arjun: Agree. Main tradeoff is inline verify latency vs silent corruption risk. We can't double token latency.

tom: My proposal: lazy-verify by default for streaming reads, but add per-chunk integrity tags in the manifest so hotstart can prioritize fully-verified shards.

jen: Love that. Also need telemetry events to detect regressions: STREAM_CHUNK_UNVERIFIED, CHUNK_VERIFIED_LATE, HOTSTART_VERIFIED_MISS, VERIFY_RETRY.

luis: Add a cheap sync check for head+tail checksums in the fast path. Catches transport/truncation bugs and is low CPU. Rest of file verified async.

maya: So plan = head/tail sync checks, lazy body, background verifier to promote shards from "lazy" -> "verified".

arjun: How about mmap fallback? If mmap path OOMs and leaves partial pages, promotion needs a deterministic re-verify step. Gate promotion on successful re-reads.

jen: Draft telemetry event (tight schema to avoid cardinality): { event: "CHUNK_VERIFY", model: "string", shard_id: "string", offset: "number", size: "number", result: "ok|corrupt|deferred", latency_ms: "number", verify_mode: "head|tail|background|sync" }

maya: Keep fields narrow. We'll feed into warmup dashboard and alert rules.

luis: Ops: background verifier must use low-priority pool and check eviction lease before promoting. Otherwise work is wasted.

arjun: On corruption: immediate origin re-fetch + fail the request if re-fetch fails. No silent degrade.

tom: Short-term implement plan:
- manifest: sha256 per-chunk + flag lazy_verify_allowed
- loader fast-path: head/tail sync verify (<=2 checks)
- per-node background verifier to sweep lazy shards async
- telemetry hooks (jen owns schema + alerts)

maya: Owners: tom (manifest+loader), jen (telemetry), luis (background verifier & leases), arjun (fallback semantics). I'll coordinate the canary.

jen: I'll add events to warmup dashboard and attach sample queries.

luis: I'll prototype verifier branch with lease checks; include a sampling mode to sync-check 5-10% chunks on new uploads to catch bad uploads cheaply.

arjun: Risk notes: increased read CPU (mitigate with sampling/background), telemetry cardinality (mitigate with schema/batching), race with eviction (lease check).

maya: I'll write a short RFC follow-up and timeline for the canary. If no objections we start the manifest header patch tomorrow.

tom: No objections. Opening the PR and will tag reviewers.

ops-bot: deploy:loader-v2 started canary on cluster-ml-7 (build: loader-v2-2026-03-21). Monitor: #eng-oncall. :rocket:

maya: Thanks team :thumbsup:
